items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: Fortunately the social chairman, the Dutch guy who was in charge of us, saw my predicament.

ctx.x: It’s sort of a leap of faith to get on the boat and, well, let’s see what happens. I heard something about your banjo broke when you got on the ship somehow.

Yes. We played on the dock as the kids were coming onboard, and then we put our instruments away and we were supposed to play at 8 o’clock that night in the lounge. So we got up to the lounge and I opened the case and I lifted the neck of the banjo and it came right off the rest of it. And there I was with strings and the banjo in two parts.
